headline: Ahn'Qiraj in 51:27, the guild's fastest by more than five minutes

mvp.headline: the most damage on Viscidus, Huhuran, the Twins and C'Thun
why: First on Viscidus, Princess Huhuran, the Twin Emperors (143k) and C'Thun (172k), second on the Bug Trio, third on Fankriss
No deaths, 6 Poison Bolt Volleys removed

also.text: the most damage on Skeram, Sartura and Ouro
tanked all nine, parse 98 on C'Thun and 95 or 96 on five more
the most healing on six bosses, 23% of it on C'Thun

overview: Nine kills on nine pulls in 51:27. The guild's next fastest is 57:00 (13 Nov) and a usual night is 1:16. C'Thun fell in 3:24 without a death, also a guild best, and Eye Beam hits ran at a quarter of the usual rate.

Three boss deaths: Osinir to Vem at 0:50, Shaaw to Sartura's Whirlwind at 0:56, and Thornhild to Ouro's melee six seconds in. Skeram went with buffs stored; from the Bug Trio on 32 to 36 raiders had Rallying Cry.
Trash cost five, three of them to an Anubisath Defender's Meteor and Shadow Storm.

wentWell.text: C'Thun in 3:24, a guild best, no deaths and 11 Eye Beam hits against about 47 usually.
All 9 of Skeram's Arcane Explosions kicked.
Bug Trio in 0:55 (median 1:21), both of Yauj's Great Heals kicked (Tochopolvo and Willythepimp).
Twin Emperors in 2:44 without a death, Blizzard at a third of the usual rate.

0:57 (median 1:10). Whirlwind killed Shaaw at 0:56, a second before the kill. Valethia top at 63k.
1:39 (median 1:59), no deaths, Poison Bolt Volley at about 60% of the usual rate.
0:38 (median 0:51), no deaths, the one Frenzy tranquilized by Punintended, 15 Nature Protection Potions.
